aspect: Probate is slow and the costs are not
description: Estate administration commonly runs six to eighteen months, during which assets may be frozen while bills continue.

aspect: Every organisation must be told separately
description: Bank, utilities, pension, insurance, subscriptions, phone, memberships - each with its own process, each wanting a copy of the certificate, each asking you to say it again.
energy_note: Announcing the death forty times to forty strangers.

aspect: Funeral costs fall due before the estate opens
description: The expenses arrive before the money that would pay for them is accessible, so survivors pay from their own accounts.
Fourteen months later a charge appears in her father's name. Cancelling needs a password nobody has, and the retention script asks whether he would like to pause instead.
energy_note: Asked, by a chatbot, whether the dead would prefer to pause.
